result.summary: The home screen has several visual/layout problems: duplicated restaurant cards, truncated names, a clipped category chip, a promo banner that overflows, and a last featured card cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The first two cards in 'Fastest near you' are identical (same Green Bowl Poké image, name, time, and delivery fee).
issues.suggestion: Load unique nearby restaurants and add a uniqueness check so the same venue is not shown twice in the carousel.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' and the image is cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Give cards a consistent width, allow two-line titles or ellipsis, and add enough right padding/peek so the last visible card is not clipped.

issues.description: The last 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height (plus safe area) so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right (Healthy is cut off, next chip only a sliver).
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a clear peek/fade so users can tell the list is scrollable, and avoid cutting chip labels.

issues.description: The green promo banner’s right side and rounded corner appear slightly cropped against the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal margin or constrain the banner so the full border-radius and artwork stay inside the safe area.

issues.description: The search field placeholder is very light gray on a light background, so 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' has weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to meet WCAG contrast guidelines while keeping it distinct from entered text.

issues.description: The notifications bell badge is a tiny red dot with no count or accessible name visible.
issues.suggestion: Use a numbered badge if there are unread items and provide an accessibility label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread'.
